newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Road King to buy China toll roads - paper.
newsitem.headline: Road King to buy China toll roads - paper.

text.p: Road King Infrastructure Ltd planned to buy part interest in two toll roads in China's Jiangsu and Henan province in October, the Hong Kong Economic Journal reported on Monday.
The company will buy part of Jiangsu's Jiangdu-Guangling Highway and a stake in the road connecting Henan's Xuchang and Nanyang, it quoted a source close to Road King as saying.
The paper did not disclose the size or the price for the deals.
Officials at Road King, a spinoff China toll-road investor and operator of Wai Kee Holdings Ltd, were not immediately available for comment.
The total investment of the 72 km-long Jiangdu-Guangling Highway was at 2.1 billion yuan and it had a operating contract for 22 year, the newspaper said.
Road King planned to upgrade the existing Henan toll road to a first class highway after the deal was fixed, it said.
